**What changed**
One change, in plain words. Link the issue it closes.

**Why**

**How to check it**
The steps a reviewer follows to see it work.

**Checklist**
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] A test covers the behavior, and it failed before the change
- [ ] Only what the issue asked changed: no unrelated refactors or style edits
- [ ] User-facing text says organization, never company; open source, never free template
- [ ] No personal data, keys, or `orgs/` contents in the diff
